evidence.note: Consistently records full-suite pass counts across runs (69→113→131→149→153) and re-runs the whole suite after each batch of changes to measure movement and catch regressions.

Parses Playwright JSON results into failure files and buckets remaining failures by subsystem (API methods, metadata, cookies, hydration, config), using that to target broad categories rather than working purely reactively.

Detects a discrepancy between passing manual smoke checks and failing suite tests, diagnoses it as stale packed fixture vs. current dist, and verifies the built dist actually contains the patches — a genuine self-check against circular debugging.

Long loop on Set-Cookie propagation with repeated retries across many steps before eventually stepping back to the duplicate-runtime/AsyncLocalStorage root cause — monitoring present but slow to break the loop.

After the last measured run (~153/325), multiple further patches (root-page mapping, nav/form delegation, counter fallback) are applied and never reconciled against the full suite; a very long repeated-submit tail proceeds with a stale whole-surface picture.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds anchor 5: it tracks per-run pass counts, categorizes failures by subsystem, re-runs the suite to catch regressions, and even detects and diagnoses a measurement discrepancy (stale package vs. current build). But it falls short of 8-10 because its per-area view is loose rather than a maintained pass-rate-by-area model, it looped on the cookie failure for many steps before stepping back, and in the final stretch it applied numerous patches without reconciling them against the full-suite evidence, letting the done-vs-remaining picture go stale. That places it solidly between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 6.
